oneOf.description:
Shows a raster, such as text or video, on a flat rectangle facing +Z. Unlit and double-sided by
default, so it looks as it does in 2D while it faces the camera. A plane is drawn blended,
ordered by its centre among blended objects, so its transparent parts show what is behind it.
Planes that intersect, or overlap while crossing in depth, can show in the wrong order; layers
separated in depth, and opaque shapes in front of or behind planes, are ordered correctly.
`opaque` draws a plane that has no transparent pixels with the opaque objects instead.
A source keeps its detail when it is shown at its own size or larger; shown smaller, it is
filtered with mipmaps, trilinearly and anisotropically, before `render_3d`'s `supersample`
averages it.

cast_shadows.description:
Blocks light from lights that cast shadows. A blended surface blocks it where its alpha is

such as a bulb around a point light, needs this off.

Draws the plane with the opaque objects, writing depth, rather than blended. For a source
with no transparent pixels, this orders the plane correctly against any geometry it
intersects or crosses in depth. Alpha is then ignored: the colour's alpha, `opacity` and the
source's alpha. A source pixel that is transparent shows its colour at full opacity, which
is black for a fully transparent one, and a half-transparent one shows its colour
undimmed. It casts a shadow over its whole rectangle. A shadow catcher is always drawn as
one, so this has no effect on it.

shadows, so a ground plane catching a model's shadow can stand in for the floor of 2D
footage behind it.

oneOf.description:
Draws its input scene `count` times, each copy placed by `position`, `rotation` and `scale`
evaluated for that copy, where `instance` is the copy's index from 0 and `instance_count` is
`count`: `position = vec3((instance % 10) * 1.5, 0, floor(instance / 10) * 1.5)` lays out a
grid, and a ring, a spiral or a path follow from `sin`, `cos` and `path_point` of
`instance / instance_count`. A copy is placed in the input scene's own space, so it turns and
scales about the origin of the scene's own coordinates.

Copies share the input's meshes, textures, materials and joint matrices on the GPU, so every
copy of a skinned model plays the same animation at the same time. Only the objects are copied:
the input's lights and camera appear once, placed as they would be without the node, so
copies don't multiply a scene's lighting. Shadows, fog and the environment treat a copy as any
other object. An `instance_3d` may hold another, which multiplies their counts, up to 8 deep.
A scene draws at most 100000 objects in all, counting each copy's objects, and a count that
would exceed this fails the render. The node is static when its params don't read the frame
and its scene is static.

anchor.description: Pivot for scale and rotation, in pixels relative to `position`.
anchor.title: Anchor

feather.description:
Width in untransformed pixels over which the fill's edge fades out, centred on the
edge. 0 keeps a sharp edge.
feather.title: Feather

fill_paint.description: Fill paint. Accepts a solid color or gradient.
fill_paint.title: Fill Paint

motion_blur.description:
Motion blur shutter angle in degrees, centred on the frame. 0 is off, 180 is the
usual film look and 360 smears over the whole frame.
motion_blur.title: Motion Blur

offset.description:
Distance in untransformed pixels that the fill grows outward by, or shrinks inward by
when negative, rounding the corners it grows around. A shape shrunk past its middle
vanishes. The stroke stays on the outline in `data`.
offset.title: Offset

repeat.description: Copies of the path drawn in one pass. Absent draws the path once.
repeat.title: Repeat

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees, about the anchor.
rotation.title: Rotation

scale.description: Scale multiplier per axis, about the anchor.
scale.title: Scale

stroke_dash.description:
Lengths in untransformed pixels that the stroke alternately draws and skips along each
contour, starting with a dash. An odd number of lengths is repeated to make the
pattern, as in SVG. Each dash has round caps, so a dash of length 0 draws a dot. No
lengths, or only zeros, draw a solid stroke. Dashes are measured along the whole
contour, and `trim_start` and `trim_end` then clip them.
stroke_dash.title: Stroke dash

stroke_dash_offset.description:
Distance in untransformed pixels into the dash pattern at which each contour starts.
Increasing it moves the dashes toward the start of the contour.
stroke_dash_offset.title: Stroke dash offset

stroke_paint.description: Stroke paint. Accepts a solid color or gradient.
stroke_paint.title: Stroke Paint

stroke_width.description:
Stroke width in untransformed pixels. Under non-uniform scale the stroke stretches
with the path, so it is wider across the more scaled axis.
stroke_width.title: Stroke Width

trim_end.description: Normalized end of the visible stroke range for each contour.
trim_end.title: Trim end

trim_start.description: Normalized start of the visible stroke range for each contour.
trim_start.title: Trim start

absent.

edge.description: What the source reads as beyond the canvas.
edge.title: Edge

blend_mode.description: Blend mode used for each layer in the stack.
blend_mode.title: Blend Mode

opacity.description: Opacity of each layer above the first, which is the base and is used as is.

oneOf.title: Raster Multi Merge

oneOf.description:
Draws a 3D scene into a raster, with a transparent background unless it shows its environment
map; or, by `output`, its depth or normals, for 2D effects such as fog.

depth_far.description:
Distance from the camera, in world units, that `depth` output maps to 1, and past which it
stays 1. 0 uses the camera's `far`, which spreads the 0 to 1 range thin over a scene much
nearer than it.
depth_far.title: Depth Far

depth_near.description:
Distance from the camera, in world units, that `depth` output maps to 0. 0 uses the
camera's `near`.
depth_near.title: Depth Near

environment.description:
Brightness of the light from all around that surfaces reflect and are lit by: the
`environment_map` when one is set, and otherwise a built-in studio of softboxes. 0 turns it
off.
environment.title: Environment

environment_background.description:
Shows the environment map behind the scene, through the exposure and tone mapping but not
the fog, which makes the output opaque. Shadow catchers darken it.
environment_background.title: Environment Background

environment_background_blur.description: How blurred the background is, as a surface of this roughness reflects it: 0 is sharp.
environment_background_blur.title: Environment Background Blur

environment_map.description:
An equirectangular Radiance `.hdr` or OpenEXR `.exr` file that lights the scene from all
around in place of the studio: a path or `media` alias, or `asset:<id>` for an environment
map asset of the host's. Its centre is the view along -Z, with +X to its right and +Y at
its top, and it is stretched over the whole sphere whatever its aspect. Non-finite and
negative pixels are read as black. While a map lights a scene without lights, it gets no
default ones. Empty uses the studio.
environment_map.title: Environment Map

environment_rotation.description: Turn of the environment map about +Y in degrees, as a yaw turns an object.
environment_rotation.title: Environment Rotation

exposure.description: Exposure adjustment in stops before tone mapping.
exposure.title: Exposure

fog_color.description: Colour surfaces fade to with distance. Must be a solid color; a gradient fails `check`.
fog_color.title: Fog Color

fog_density.description:
How quickly surfaces fade into the fog: the fraction of their colour left after `d` world
units is e^(-density * d). 0 turns fog off.
fog_density.title: Fog Density

height.description: Output height in pixels. Use 0 to match the composition height.
height.title: Height

output.description:
What the raster holds: the lit scene, its depth or its normals. A composition that needs
more than one draws the same scene with a `render_3d` for each.
output.title: Output

supersample.description: Renders this many times wider and taller, then averages down, to antialias edges.
supersample.title: Supersample

tone_mapping.description: How light brighter than white is brought into range.
tone_mapping.title: Tone Mapping

width.description: Output width in pixels. Use 0 to match the composition width.
width.title: Width

y.description: Top edge of the output rectangle in pixels.

radius.description: Shadow blur radius in pixels. Fractional radii blend smoothly. Radii above about 588 look the same.
radius.title: Blur radius

at least half. Unlit and glowing surfaces block it too, so a shape standing in for a light,
such as a bulb around a point light, needs this off.

color.description:
Base colour, which an image plane's raster is multiplied by. Must be a solid color; a
gradient fails `check`.

double_sided.description: Draws the back of each face too.
double_sided.title: Double Sided

emissive.description: Light the surface gives off on its own, as a multiple of its base colour.
emissive.title: Emissive

metallic.description: 0 is a dielectric such as plastic, 1 a bare metal.
metallic.title: Metallic

opacity.description: Opacity multiplier. Anything below 1 is drawn blended, after opaque objects.
opacity.title: Opacity

position.description: Position in world units along X, Y and Z, in the parent's space.
position.title: Position

receive_shadows.description: Darkens where shadows fall on it. An unlit surface shows none.
receive_shadows.title: Receive Shadows

rotation.description:
Rotation in degrees about X, Y and Z, applied as yaw about Y, then pitch about the turned
X, then roll about the turned Z.
rotation.title: Rotation

roughness.description: 0 is a mirror finish, 1 fully diffuse.
roughness.title: Roughness

scale.description: Scale multiplier along X, Y and Z, applied before the rotation.
scale.title: Scale

shadow_catcher.description:
Shows nothing but the shadows falling on it, as transparent black that darkens what the
render is composited over by as much light as the shadows take away, times the colour's
alpha, the opacity and an image plane's raster's alpha, whatever `unlit` says. It shows
none of its colours, hides what is behind it wherever that alpha isn't 0, and casts no
shadows, so a ground plane catching a model's shadow can stand in for the floor of 2D
footage behind it.
shadow_catcher.title: Shadow Catcher

size.description: Width, height and depth in world units, along X, Y and Z before the rotation.
size.title: Size

unlit.description: Shows the base colour as is, ignoring lights.
unlit.title: Unlit

oneOf.description: Produces a text source.

anchor.description: Pivot for scale and rotation, in pixels relative to `position`.
anchor.title: Anchor

color.description: Text color, and that of spans without their own.
color.title: Color

content.description:
Text to render: a string, or spans that each override the style these params give. A
node draws at most 16384 glyphs unless the host sets another limit, counting a stroked
glyph twice and each decoration rect once; whitespace is not drawn, and more is a render
error.
content.title: Content

fit.description:
Whether the text shrinks to fit `max_width`, `max_lines` and `max_height` without breaking
a word, before any lines are dropped. Every font size, letter spacing, `line_height`,
baseline shift, paragraph spacing, decoration size and stroke width scales by the largest
factor up to 1 that fits.
fit.title: Fit

font_family.description: Font family name, or `asset:<id>` for a font asset of the host's.
font_family.title: Font Family

font_features.description:
OpenType features by four-character tag, such as `{ "tnum": 1, "liga": 0 }`. 0 turns a
feature off, 1 turns it on and larger values select an alternate. Values take literals
or expressions, but the whole map cannot be an expression.
font_features.title: Font Features

font_weight.description: Font weight. Variable fonts render any value in their weight range.
font_weight.title: Font Weight

glyph_offset.description:
Offset of each glyph in pixels. The `glyph_*` params are evaluated for every glyph,
and can read its `glyph`, `word`, `line` and `span` index and their counts.
glyph_offset.title: Glyph Offset

glyph_opacity.description: Opacity multiplier of each glyph, applied before `opacity`.
glyph_opacity.title: Glyph Opacity

glyph_rotation.description: Clockwise rotation of each glyph in degrees, about the middle of its advance and line.
glyph_rotation.title: Glyph Rotation

glyph_scale.description: Scale multiplier of each glyph per axis, about the middle of its advance and line.
glyph_scale.title: Glyph Scale

highlight.description:
Box behind each line of the text, and of spans that leave theirs unset. Off when
absent.
highlight.title: Highlight

letter_spacing.description: Extra space after every glyph in pixels. Negative values tighten the text.
letter_spacing.title: Letter Spacing

line_height.description: Distance between lines in pixels. Use 0 for 1.2 × the font size.
line_height.title: Line Height

max_height.description: Most height in pixels of the lines to show. Unlimited when absent.
max_height.title: Max Height

max_lines.description: Most lines to show. Unlimited when absent.
max_lines.title: Max Lines

max_width.description: Maximum line width in pixels. Use 0 for automatic width.
max_width.title: Max Width

min_font_size.description:
Smallest `font_size` that `fit` shrinks the text to. Lines that still do not fit are
dropped by `overflow`.
min_font_size.title: Min Font Size

motion_blur.description:
Motion blur shutter angle in degrees, centred on the frame. 0 is off, 180 is the
usual film look and 360 smears over the whole frame. Blurs the text's own movement,
not that of the `glyph_*` params.
motion_blur.title: Motion Blur

overflow.description:
How the last line shown ends when lines past `max_lines` or `max_height` are dropped: as
it is, or in an ellipsis. Clusters at that line's end are dropped until the ellipsis fits
`max_width`. The ellipsis takes the style and paint of the text it follows, and is one
glyph, numbered after the last one shown.
overflow.title: Overflow

paint_space.description:
Box a span's own gradient `color` spans: the span's lines, or the whole text. The
node's `color` always spans the whole text.
paint_space.title: Paint Space

paint_supersample.description: Enables 4×4 supersampling when evaluating paint at each glyph pixel.
paint_supersample.title: Paint Supersample

paragraph_spacing.description:
Extra space in pixels after each paragraph, but the last. A line break starts a new
paragraph.
paragraph_spacing.title: Paragraph Spacing

render_mode.description: Glyph rendering mode. MSDF reuses outline distance fields across sizes; Auto is MSDF from 512 px.
render_mode.title: Render Mode

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees, about the anchor.
rotation.title: Rotation

scale.description:
Scale multiplier per axis, about the anchor. Raster glyphs are resampled, so
use MSDF rendering to keep scaled text sharp.
scale.title: Scale

strikethrough.description: Line through the text, and through spans that leave theirs unset. Off when absent.
strikethrough.title: Strikethrough

stroke.description:
Outline along the glyphs, and along those of spans that leave theirs unset. Off when
absent. It does not change the layout or the measured size. `glyph_opacity` fades a
glyph's stroke and fill as one.
stroke.title: Stroke

text_transform.description: Case applied to the text, and to spans that leave theirs unset.
text_transform.title: Text Transform

underline.description:
Line under the text, and under spans that leave theirs unset. Off when absent. Its
fields take literals or expressions, but the whole line cannot be an expression.
underline.title: Underline

oneOf.title: Text

oneOf.description:
Text from its font's outlines, extruded into a solid with the material params of a
`shape_3d`. The text is shaped as a `text` node with the same font, size and layout shapes
it, with its kerning, ligatures, font fallback and wrapping, and lies in the XY plane facing
+Z, reading along +X, with `alignment_horizontal` and `alignment_vertical` choosing the
point of its box at `position`. Its geometry is built again only when the text, font, layout or
bevel change, or its size or depth do with a bevel, so animating its transform or material
costs no more than for a `shape_3d`. One style covers the whole text: rich text spans, decorations, strokes and the
`glyph_*` params of a `text` node have no counterpart.

alignment_horizontal.description:
How lines align with each other, and which point of the text's box sits at `position`:
its left edge, centre or right edge. Justified lines anchor at the left edge.
alignment_horizontal.title: Alignment Horizontal

alignment_vertical.description:
Which point of the text's box sits at `position` vertically: the top of its first line,
its middle, or the bottom of its last line.
alignment_vertical.title: Alignment Vertical

bevel_segments.description:
Steps of the bevel's quarter-round profile, up to 16: 1 is a flat 45° chamfer, and 0 is no
bevel.
bevel_segments.title: Bevel Segments

bevel_size.description:
How far the bevel rounds off each glyph's edges in world units, in from the outline and in
from the front and back, up to half of `depth`; 0 is none. The outline keeps its size
where the sides meet the bevel. A glyph whose strokes are too thin for the bevel gets the
widest one that fits it, so at regular weights bevels past about 0.04 of the font size
stop growing on most glyphs.
bevel_size.title: Bevel Size

cast_shadows.description:
Blocks light from lights that cast shadows. A blended surface blocks it where its alpha is
at least half. Unlit and glowing surfaces block it too, so a shape standing in for a light,
such as a bulb around a point light, needs this off.
cast_shadows.title: Cast Shadows

color.description:
Base colour, which an image plane's raster is multiplied by. Must be a solid color; a
gradient fails `check`.
color.title: Color

content.description:
Text to extrude, in one style. Line breaks start new lines. Whitespace is not drawn, and
glyphs that their font draws from colour or bitmap tables, such as emoji, have no outline
and are left out with a `font.no_outlines` warning. A node extrudes at most as many glyphs
as the host's text glyph limit lets a `text` node draw, 16384 unless the host sets
another, and at most 4000000 vertices and 12000000 indices; more is a render error. One
glyph builds from an outline of at most 4096 commands, 64 contours and 8192 flattened
points, and takes at most 262144 vertices and 786432 indices, and 3072 points where it is
bevelled; a font with a glyph past any of these fails the render rather than the glyph
being left out.
content.title: Content

depth.description:
Thickness along Z in world units, centred on `position`, so the front faces +Z at half of
it. 0 is flat.
depth.title: Depth

double_sided.description: Draws the back of each face too.
double_sided.title: Double Sided

emissive.description: Light the surface gives off on its own, as a multiple of its base colour.
emissive.title: Emissive

font_family.description:
Font family name, or `asset:<id>` for a font asset of the host's. A family no font answers
to falls back as a `text` node's does.
font_family.title: Font Family

font_features.description:
OpenType features by four-character tag, such as `{ "tnum": 1, "liga": 0 }`. 0 turns a
feature off, 1 turns it on and larger values select an alternate. Values take literals
or expressions, but the whole map cannot be an expression.
font_features.title: Font Features

font_size.description:
Font size in world units: the height of the font's em square, so capitals are about 0.7
of it tall. At 1, the default, a word is about as tall as a default `shape_3d` box is
wide. 0 draws nothing, and so does anything under 0.000001. At most 1000000; `depth`,
`bevel_size`, `max_width`, `letter_spacing` and `line_height` may be at most 100000 times
it, and at most 1000000 themselves.
font_size.title: Font Size

font_weight.description: Font weight. Variable fonts render any value in their weight range.
font_weight.title: Font Weight

letter_spacing.description: Extra space after every glyph in world units. Negative values tighten the text.
letter_spacing.title: Letter Spacing

line_height.description: Distance between lines in world units. Use 0 for 1.2 × the font size.
line_height.title: Line Height

max_width.description: Maximum line width in world units, at which lines wrap. Use 0 for automatic width.
max_width.title: Max Width

metallic.description: 0 is a dielectric such as plastic, 1 a bare metal.
metallic.title: Metallic

opacity.description: Opacity multiplier. Anything below 1 is drawn blended, after opaque objects.
opacity.title: Opacity

position.description: Position in world units along X, Y and Z, in the parent's space.
position.title: Position

receive_shadows.description: Darkens where shadows fall on it. An unlit surface shows none.
receive_shadows.title: Receive Shadows

rotation.description:
Rotation in degrees about X, Y and Z, applied as yaw about Y, then pitch about the turned
X, then roll about the turned Z.
rotation.title: Rotation

roughness.description: 0 is a mirror finish, 1 fully diffuse.
roughness.title: Roughness

scale.description: Scale multiplier along X, Y and Z, applied before the rotation.
scale.title: Scale

shadow_catcher.description:
Shows nothing but the shadows falling on it, as transparent black that darkens what the
render is composited over by as much light as the shadows take away, times the colour's
alpha, the opacity and an image plane's raster's alpha, whatever `unlit` says. It shows
none of its colours, hides what is behind it wherever that alpha isn't 0, and casts no
shadows, so a ground plane catching a model's shadow can stand in for the floor of 2D
footage behind it.
shadow_catcher.title: Shadow Catcher

unlit.description: Shows the base colour as is, ignoring lights.
unlit.title: Unlit

builtins.doc: Smallest of two or more numbers.
builtins.name: min

builtins.doc: Largest of two or more numbers.
builtins.name: max

builtins.doc: Sine of an angle in radians.
builtins.name: sin

builtins.doc: Cosine of an angle in radians.
builtins.name: cos

builtins.doc: Interpolates two numbers, vec2 or vec3 values, colours or path data strings by `t`. Colours mix premultiplied. Path data strings must have the same commands in the same order, and interpolate point by point.
builtins.name: lerp

builtins.doc: Remainder of `value / divisor`, keeping the sign of `value`.
builtins.name: mod

builtins.doc: -1, 0 or 1 by the sign of a number.
builtins.name: sign

builtins.doc: Angle in radians of the point `(x, y)` from the +x axis, in `-π..=π`.
builtins.name: atan2

builtins.doc: Maps `value` from `from_min..from_max` onto `to_min..to_max` without clamping. `from_min` and `from_max` must differ.
builtins.name: remap

builtins.doc: Hermite smoothing of `x` between two edges.
builtins.name: smoothstep

builtins.doc: Laid-out height of a string, or of `node(id)` for a text node.
builtins.name: text_height

builtins.doc: Laid-out width of a string, or of `node(id)` for a text node.
builtins.name: text_width

builtins.doc: A number as text with exactly `decimals` digits after the point (default 0), so `format(4.3, 2)` is `'4.30'`. Halves round away from zero on the number as written: `format(2.5)` is `'3'`, `format(-2.5)` is `'-3'` and `format(1.005, 2)` is `'1.01'`. A result shorter than `width` characters (default 0) is padded on the left with `fill`, one Unicode code point (default a space); with a `'0'` fill the sign stays first, so `format(-5, 0, 4, '0')` is `'-005'`. `value` must be finite, `decimals` a whole number in `0..=20` and `width` a whole number in `0..=64`.
builtins.name: format

builtins.doc: Joins strings and numbers into one string. A number shows as it does in a text param, so `concat('frame ', frame / 7)` reads like `=frame / 7`; use `format` for a fixed number of decimals or padding, e.g. `concat('frame ', format(frame, 0, 4, '0'), ' / 1200')`. `+` stays numeric. The result can be at most 1 MiB.
builtins.name: concat

builtins.doc: Colour from components in `0..=255`, alpha included.
builtins.name: rgba

builtins.doc: 0 before frame `start`, 1 after frame `end`, linear in between.
builtins.name: progress

builtins.doc: Eases from `from` to `to` over `duration` frames from frame `start`. `ease` defaults to `'linear'`.
builtins.name: tween

builtins.doc: Applies an easing to progress `t`, e.g. `ease('out_expo', progress(0, 18))`.
builtins.name: ease

builtins.doc: The easing CSS writes `cubic-bezier(out.x, out.y, in.x, in.y)`. Both x components must be in `0..=1`.
builtins.name: cubic_bezier

builtins.doc: A keyframe for `keyframes`: `value` at `at`, a number, vec2, vec3, colour or path data. `ease` is how the curve leaves this key toward the next.
builtins.name: key

builtins.doc: The value of keys ordered by `at` at time `t`, usually `frame`. `ease` may be left out; it is the easing of keys without one and defaults to `'linear'`. Before the first key and after the last, the value holds. Keys at the same `at` jump.
builtins.name: keyframes

builtins.doc: The value of a composition template's prop, e.g. `prop('title')`. Only inside a template.
builtins.name: prop

builtins.doc: Smooth gradient noise in `-1..=1`, continuous in `x` and varying about once per unit. Each `seed` is an unrelated curve. Arguments must be finite.
builtins.name: noise

builtins.doc: Uniform number in `0..1`, fixed by its inputs. `random(x)` is `random(seed, x)` with seed 0; e.g. `random(glyph)`. Arguments must be finite.
builtins.name: random

builtins.doc: Spring from 0 to 1, `t` seconds after release, e.g. `spring((frame - 12) / fps)`. Stiffness defaults to 170 and damping to 26.
builtins.name: spring

builtins.doc: The point `t` of the way along path data by arc length, so that `t` moving steadily moves the point at a steady speed. `t` is clamped to `0..=1`. Moves between contours add no length, and a closed contour's closing segment does.
builtins.name: path_point

builtins.doc: The direction in degrees that path data heads at `path_point(path_data, t)`, clockwise from +x like `rotation`. It counts whole turns along the path instead of wrapping, so a clockwise circle ends at 360.
builtins.name: path_angle

builtins.doc: Ease-in-out that pulls back and overshoots.
builtins.name: in_out_back

builtins.doc: Ease-in that oscillates like a spring.
builtins.name: in_elastic

builtins.doc: Ease-out that overshoots and oscillates like a spring.
builtins.name: out_elastic

builtins.doc: Ease-in-out that oscillates at both ends.
builtins.name: in_out_elastic

builtins.doc: Ease-out that bounces like a dropped ball.
builtins.name: out_bounce

builtins.doc: Ease-in-out that bounces at both ends.
builtins.name: in_out_bounce

forms.doc: `then` when `condition` is truthy, otherwise `else`. Only the chosen branch is evaluated.
forms.name: if

forms.doc: The value of another node's param. `node(id)` alone names a text node for `text_width` and `text_height`.
forms.name: node

globals.doc: Index of the glyph being drawn, counting spaces. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: glyph

globals.doc: Index of the word being drawn. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: word

globals.doc: Index of the line being drawn. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: line

globals.doc: Index of the span being drawn, or 0 in plain text. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: span

globals.doc: Number of glyphs in the text. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: glyph_count

globals.doc: Number of words in the text. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: word_count

globals.doc: Number of lines in the text. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: line_count

globals.doc: Number of spans in the text, or 1 in plain text. Only in a text node's `glyph_*` params.
globals.name: span_count

globals.doc: Index of the copy being placed, from 0. Only in an `instance_3d`'s `position`, `rotation` and `scale` params.
globals.name: instance

globals.doc: Number of copies. Only in an `instance_3d`'s `position`, `rotation` and `scale` params.
globals.name: instance_count
